We need solve equation:
\[
\frac{(x+1)(x-3)}{5(x+2)(x-4)}+\frac{(x+3)(x-5)}{9(x+4)(x-6)}-\frac{2(x+5)(x-7)}{13(x+6)(x-8)}=\frac{92}{585}.
\]

Let \(t=x-1\). Then
\[
(x+1)(x-3)=(t+2)(t-4),\quad (x+2)(x-4)=(t+3)(t-5),
\]
and similarly for the other terms. Notice
\[
(t+2)(t-4)=(t+3)(t-5)+7,
\]
\[
(t+4)(t-6)=(t+5)(t-7)+11,
\]
\[
(t+6)(t-8)=(t+7)(t-9)+15.
\]
Thus the left side becomes
\[
\frac15+\frac19-\frac{2}{13}
+\frac{7}{5(t+3)(t-5)}+\frac{11}{9(t+5)(t-7)}+\frac{30}{13(t+7)(t-9)}.
\]
But
\[
\frac15+\frac19-\frac{2}{13}=\frac{92}{585},
\]
so the equation reduces to
\[
\frac{7}{5(t+3)(t-5)}+\frac{11}{9(t+5)(t-7)}+\frac{30}{13(t+7)(t-9)}=0.
\]

Now observe
\[
(t+3)(t-5)=(t-1)^2-16,
\]
\[
(t+5)(t-7)=(t-1)^2-36,
\]
\[
(t+7)(t-9)=(t-1)^2-64.
\]
Since \(t=x-1\), let
\[
z=(t-1)^2=(x-2)^2.
\]
Then
\[
\frac{7}{5(z-16)}+\frac{11}{9(z-36)}+\frac{30}{13(z-64)}=0.
\]

Multiplying by \((z-16)(z-36)(z-64)\) gives
\[
\frac75(z-36)(z-64)+\frac{11}{9}(z-16)(z-64)+\frac{30}{13}(z-16)(z-36)=0.
\]
Expanding and simplifying yields
\[
2884z^2-11244z+11244=0.
\]
Divide by 4:
\[
721z^2-2811z+2811=0.
\]
Using the quadratic formula,
\[
z=\frac{2811\pm\sqrt{2811^2-4\cdot721\cdot2811}}{2\cdot721}.
\]
The discriminant is
\[
2811^2-4\cdot721\cdot2811=2811(2811-2884)=-2811\cdot73<0.
\]
So there are no real values of \(z\).

Therefore the original equation has no real roots.

\[
\boxed{\text{no real roots}}
\]
